# hosts

The files in this directory are official brand assets or theme-specific derivatives of official assets. `deepseek-wordmark-dark.svg` only sets the official SVG's inherited `currentColor` to white for dark-mode rendering.

## 中文说明

创建、读取和修改 Word 文档，适合报告、合同、方案、批注稿和模板化文档。

## 典型场景
- 生成带标题、段落和列表的 Word 文档
- 读取已有 .docx 并提取关键信息
- 修改文档内容、结构和格式后重新导出

# Supported-host logo sources

The files in this directory are official brand assets or theme-specific
derivatives of official assets. `deepseek-wordmark-dark.svg` only sets the
official SVG's inherited `currentColor` to white for dark-mode rendering.

| Asset | Official source |
|---|---|
| Claude Code | [Anthropic press kit](https://www.anthropic.com/press-kit) |
| Hermes Agent | [NousResearch/hermes-agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/main/website/static/img/hermes-agent-banner.png) |
| OpenClaw | [openclaw/openclaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/tree/d74a12264aa5fb0598605e8f04e1864b7239ddd5/docs/assets) |
| Codex | Resized from the Codex product icons bundled with the official ChatGPT desktop app; see [OpenAI's Codex documentation](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/codex) |
| DeepSeek Harness | [deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/website/public/wordmark.svg) |
| Pi coding agent | [Pi press kit](https://pi.dev/press-kit) |
| Grok Build | [xai-org/grok-build](https://github.com/xai-org/grok-build) |
| OpenCode | [anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/tree/dev/packages/console/app/src/asset) |

All product names, logos, and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
Their presence documents compatibility and does not imply endorsement.
